name: mirage
text: Working on three Kalshi fixes for v1.0.22: (1) bet slip: the row now leaves the list the moment you press Bet and stays off after rescans (returns after 15 s only if no order was recorded); (2) Kalshi bids: a bid sized at half a contract or more now rounds to 1 contract instead of 'under one contract'; (3) Kalshi scanning: the GitHub engine already scans Kalshi; it now also publishes its list and the phone reads that list instead of scanning Kalshi itself (falls back to its own scan if the engine list is older than 10 min).
